memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the region code derived from
                the postcode (falling back to the city). FY is the two-digit
                fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. HASH8
                is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized telephone followed by lastName. CHK is a single Luhn
                check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
                When this base id collides with an existing owner's, '-<n>' is
                appended with the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it unique.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household - the
                same last name and postcode. Deterministically derived as the
                first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                'normalizedLastName|postcode', so owners with the same last name
                and postcode automatically receive the same value. Absent when the
                owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: '8F14E45FCEEA'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the full lower-case SHA-256 hex
                digest over
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>' (the
                email segment is empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates
                exactly when their whole identity keys are equal; a create request
                whose identity key matches an existing owner's is rejected with
                409.
              type: string
              example: '75081e2648c06081f40036cec119d35b9232ff73ab34b2d0fd75c473a8ef4fa0'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is
            used to compose the read-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a single flat line. On response it is the composed
            address: the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            supplied (non-blank) the structured fields are preferred over the
            flat 'address'. Normalized like the flat address (trim, collapse
            whitespace, upper-case, expand common street-type abbreviations).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized like 'addressLine1' and,
            when present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be valid for the city's region using a fixed table keyed by the city's
            region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. The stored and returned value is the supplied string.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise the country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The stored
            and returned value is this E.164 string, e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. The stored and returned value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the read-only 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used only on create. When true, the owner may be
            created even if another owner already has the same last name and the
            same postcode (i.e. they share a household); it only bypasses the
            household duplicate block and does not itself assign the householdId.
            A declared household member is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It
            is never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical link to this owner, derived on read as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read as the 'title' followed
                by a single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just
                the lastName when no title is present.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, derived on
                read: the country calling code, a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes separated by spaces (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field keeps the
                unformatted E.164 value.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the region code derived from
                the postcode (falling back to the city). FY is the two-digit
                fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. HASH8
                is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized telephone followed by lastName. CHK is a single Luhn
                check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
                When this base id collides with an existing owner's, '-<n>' is
                appended with the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it unique.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household - the
                same last name and postcode. Deterministically derived as the
                first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                'normalizedLastName|postcode', so owners with the same last name
                and postcode automatically receive the same value. Absent when the
                owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: '8F14E45FCEEA'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the full lower-case SHA-256 hex
                digest over
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>' (the
                email segment is empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates
                exactly when their whole identity keys are equal; a create request
                whose identity key matches an existing owner's is rejected with
                409.
              type: string
              example: '75081e2648c06081f40036cec119d35b9232ff73ab34b2d0fd75c473a8ef4fa0'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on
                create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the FY
                segment of the memberId (the two-digit fiscal year of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate). The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is labelled by the calendar year in which it starts,
                so a registrationDate on or after 1 July falls in that year's
                fiscal year and one before 1 July falls in the previous year's
                (e.g. a registrationDate of 2026-09-06 yields 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from the owner's factors.
                Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when the
                owner's namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more,
                plus 3 when tenure exceeds one fiscal year (i.e. the number of
                elapsed fiscal years since registration is more than 1).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and
                4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived on read as the REGION segment of the
                memberId (the region code baked into the
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' identity). 'UNKNOWN' when neither the
                postcode nor the city resolves to a known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived on read from the 'locality'
                region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW ->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD ->
                Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region does not resolve to a
                known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, derived on read and formatted
                '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or
                more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is
                a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                A soft warning flag, derived on read: true when more than 80
                owners have been created (by registrationDate) on the same day
                as this owner, otherwise false. Signals unusually high signup
                volume for the day before the hard per-day create limit is
                reached.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                A soft warning flag, derived on read: true when the owner's city
                already holds between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard
                per-city capacity limit of 50), otherwise false. Signals a city
                nearing capacity before the hard rejection at 50 is reached.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                A soft-match flag, set on creation: true when this owner is not a
                hard duplicate but, at the moment it was created, shared an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone, otherwise false. When true,
                'possibleDuplicateOf' holds the matching owner's id.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner whose last name and postcode this
                owner shares (with a different telephone), captured on creation.
                Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived on read from the 'birthDate'
                against the 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT'
                for 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Absent when no
                birth date is present.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) and
                retains the record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create
                endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A soft risk indicator, derived on read: true when any of the
                following hold - the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (not itself a blocklisted disposable domain
                but a subdomain of one, or sharing a blocklisted domain's
                second-level label under a different suffix), or the city is
                over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is true); otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is
            used to compose the read-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a single flat line. On response it is the composed
            address: the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            supplied (non-blank) the structured fields are preferred over the
            flat 'address'. Normalized like the flat address (trim, collapse
            whitespace, upper-case, expand common street-type abbreviations).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized like 'addressLine1' and,
            when present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be valid for the city's region using a fixed table keyed by the city's
            region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. The stored and returned value is the supplied string.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise the country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The stored
            and returned value is this E.164 string, e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. The stored and returned value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the read-only 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used only on create. When true, the owner may be
            created even if another owner already has the same last name and the
            same postcode (i.e. they share a household); it only bypasses the
            household duplicate block and does not itself assign the householdId.
            A declared household member is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It
            is never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical link to this owner, derived on read as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read as the 'title' followed
                by a single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just
                the lastName when no title is present.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, derived on
                read: the country calling code, a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes separated by spaces (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field keeps the
                unformatted E.164 value.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract carried by this
                response. Always 2 for the version-2 owner identity, under which
                the identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId) are grouped
                under the nested 'identity' object and are rederived with a
                version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identifiers, grouped together: the unified
                memberId, the shared householdId and the derived identityKey.
                Every identifier is rederived with a version-2 algorithm that
                mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag, so no value produced under
                version 1 is produced again.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on
                create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the FY
                segment of the memberId (the two-digit fiscal year of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate). The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is labelled by the calendar year in which it starts,
                so a registrationDate on or after 1 July falls in that year's
                fiscal year and one before 1 July falls in the previous year's
                (e.g. a registrationDate of 2026-09-06 yields 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from the owner's factors.
                Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when the
                owner's namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more,
                plus 3 when tenure exceeds one fiscal year (i.e. the number of
                elapsed fiscal years since registration is more than 1).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and
                4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived on read as the REGION segment of the
                memberId (the region code baked into the
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' identity). 'UNKNOWN' when neither the
                postcode nor the city resolves to a known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived on read from the 'locality'
                region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW ->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD ->
                Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region does not resolve to a
                known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, derived on read and formatted
                '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or
                more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is
                a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                A soft warning flag, derived on read: true when more than 80
                owners have been created (by registrationDate) on the same day
                as this owner, otherwise false. Signals unusually high signup
                volume for the day before the hard per-day create limit is
                reached.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                A soft warning flag, derived on read: true when the owner's city
                already holds between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard
                per-city capacity limit of 50), otherwise false. Signals a city
                nearing capacity before the hard rejection at 50 is reached.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                A soft-match flag, set on creation: true when this owner is not a
                hard duplicate but, at the moment it was created, shared an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone, otherwise false. When true,
                'possibleDuplicateOf' holds the matching owner's id.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner whose last name and postcode this
                owner shares (with a different telephone), captured on creation.
                Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived on read from the 'birthDate'
                against the 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT'
                for 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Absent when no
                birth date is present.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) and
                retains the record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create
                endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A soft risk indicator, derived on read: true when any of the
                following hold - the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (not itself a blocklisted disposable domain
                but a subdomain of one, or sharing a blocklisted domain's
                second-level label under a different suffix), or the city is
                over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is true); otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
